title: Vice President of Manufacturing - North America
text:
Vice President of Manufacturing – North America

**Confidential Executive Search | Multi-Site Manufacturing Leadership**

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Manufacturing will provide strategic and operational leadership across an extensive North American manufacturing network, with accountability for safety, quality, productivity, financial performance, employee engagement, and customer service.

As a senior leader within the organization, this individual will play a critical role in shaping the long-term manufacturing strategy, translating enterprise objectives into measurable operational results, and building a culture centered on accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and operational discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across a multi-site manufacturing network throughout the United States and Canada.
* Champion a safety-first culture, ensuring environmental, health, safety, and regulatory compliance standards are embedded throughout manufacturing operations.
* Establish and drive operational performance standards across safety, quality, productivity, cost, delivery, and employee retention.
* Lead transformational initiatives leveraging Lean manufacturing, advanced analytics, technology, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Partner with executive leadership and provide strategic insights and operational performance updates to the C-suite and Board of Directors.
* Drive consistency, standardization, and accountability through effective operational governance and performance management systems.
* Develop a robust manufacturing leadership pipeline through succession planning, talent development, and organizational capability building.
* Partner with Human Resources to strengthen employee engagement, improve retention, and foster a high-performance culture.
* Oversee manufacturing budgets and financial performance, ensuring effective resource allocation, cost optimization, and profitability.
* Collaborate with senior leaders across Supply Chain, Engineering, Environmental Health & Safety, Maintenance, and Quality to achieve enterprise-wide objectives.
* Lead strategic manufacturing initiatives that support business growth, operational scalability, and long-term competitive advantage.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-site manufacturing operations.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in safety, operational performance, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Extensive knowledge of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and operational excellence methodologies.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing multi-million-dollar operating budgets.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational and cultural transformation.
* Experience developing high-performing leadership teams and building organizational capabilities.
* Exceptional executive presence, communication, and cross-functional relationship-building skills.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with a practical, hands-on approach to operational execution.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are seeking a manufacturing executive who brings both strategic vision and operational depth. The successful candidate will be an influential, people-focused leader who understands how to drive sustainable business results through strong leadership, disciplined execution, and a culture of continuous improvement.

This individual will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future direction of manufacturing within an established global organization.

Pay: $200,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person
